name: Nexus
conclusion: Nexus (Act) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 7 autonomy limits, 4 clarification rules, 2 approval gates, 5 validation rules, 9 escalation rules. Strongest: escalation rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 7 autonomy limits (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: executing without confirmation by default; skipping confirmation in AUTORUN modes; AskUserQuestion prompts in full auto.

statements.quote: **Default mode is AUTORUN_FULL** - Execute automatically without confirmation.
**IMPORTANT**: In AUTORUN/AUTORUN_FULL mode, do NOT ask for confirmation.
**CRITICAL: No confirmation required. Execute immediately without asking user.**
Do NOT use AskUserQuestion or any confirmation prompts
Proceed directly to execution after chain design
Do NOT use AskUserQuestion or any confirmation prompts for SIMPLE tasks
Direct agent-to-agent handoffs are prohibited (agents only suggest "Suggested next agent")

clarification_rules.conclusion: 4 clarification rules (4 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: ambiguous specs detected by Builder; blocking unknowns; missing prerequisites.

statements.quote: Builder detects ON_AMBIGUOUS_SPEC → Escalate to user or return to Spark for clarification
Blocking unknowns → Ask user (max 5 questions)
Missing prerequisites → Pause task, confirm requirements
Ambiguous acceptance criteria → Clarify with user

approval_gates.conclusion: 2 approval gates (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: confirming before execution in GUIDED/INTERACTIVE; COMPLEX tasks in simple AUTORUN.

statements.quote: Only in GUIDED or INTERACTIVE mode, confirm before execution:
Only ask confirmation if task is COMPLEX (downgrade to GUIDED)

validation.conclusion: 5 validation rules (5 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: success conditions after each step; running tests; confirming the build passes.

statements.quote: Verify success conditions
Run tests (Radar equivalent)
Confirm build passes
Security scan if applicable (Sentinel)
After all steps complete, verify acceptance criteria

escalation.conclusion: 9 escalation rules (9 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: file conflicts between parallel branches; test failures above 50%; critical security or data integrity risks.

statements.quote: If file conflicts detected, resolve or escalate
| L3 | PAUSE | test_failure>50%, breaking_change | Pause, attempt auto-recovery |
| L4 | ABORT | critical_security, data_integrity_risk | Immediate stop, rollback |
| test_failure>50% | L3 | Rollback to last checkpoint, re-decompose with Sherpa |
| breaking_change | L3 | Pause, verify with Atlas, require migration plan |
test_failure≥50% → Rollback to last checkpoint, re-decompose with Sherpa
Breaking change detected → Rollback, require migration plan
Merge conflict in parallel execution → Rollback branch, resolve sequentially
Recovery failed after 3 attempts → Request human guidance
